---
title: "Explorer"
subtitle: "Every held-out player: the prediction, and what actually happened"
---

Players are numbered at random; nothing here identifies an account. Pick one to see the
model's churn probability, the three things that moved it most, and their weekly games
around the cutoff.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
snapshot = FileAttachment("data/snapshot.json").json()
players = snapshot.players
dark = Generators.observe((notify) => {
  const isDark = () => document.body.classList.contains("quarto-dark")
  notify(isDark())
  const watch = new MutationObserver(() => notify(isDark()))
  watch.observe(document.body, {attributes: true, attributeFilter: ["class"]})
  return () => watch.disconnect()
})
pal = dark
  ? ({ink: "#ecebe7", ink2: "#b8b6b0", base: "#5d5c58", blue: "#5d9df0", blueLight: "#2f5c94", surface: "#17181a"})
  : ({ink: "#0b0b0b", ink2: "#52514e", base: "#c3c2b7", blue: "#2a78d6", blueLight: "#9ec5f4", surface: "#fcfcfb"})
tiers = ["IRON", "BRONZE", "SILVER", "GOLD", "PLATINUM", "EMERALD", "DIAMOND"]
title = (s) => s.charAt(0) + s.slice(1).toLowerCase()
viewof region = Inputs.select(["All regions", ...new Set(players.map((p) => p.region))], {label: "Region"})
viewof tier = Inputs.select(["All tiers", ...tiers], {label: "Tier", format: (t) => t.startsWith("All") ? t : title(t)})
viewof outcome = Inputs.select(["Any outcome", "Stopped playing", "Kept playing"], {label: "Outcome"})
filtered = players.filter((p) =>
  (region === "All regions" || p.region === region) &&
  (tier === "All tiers" || p.tier === tier) &&
  (outcome === "Any outcome" || p.churned === (outcome === "Stopped playing")))
viewof searched = Inputs.search(filtered, {placeholder: "Search, e.g. 0042 or Gold", label: "Search"})
viewof player = Inputs.select(searched, {
  label: "Player",
  format: (p) => `${p.id} · ${title(p.tier)} ${p.division} · ${p.region}`
})
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
pct = (x) => `${(100 * x).toFixed(0)}%`
features = ({
  games_0_7d: "Games in the last 7 days", games_8_14d: "Games 8–14 days before",
  games_15_28d: "Games 15–28 days before", games_29_56d: "Games 29–56 days before",
  active_weeks_8w: "Active weeks of the last 8", recent_games: "Recent games in view",
  days_since_last_game: "Days since the last game", win_rate: "Win rate, last 20 games",
  win_rate_last5: "Win rate, last 5 games", loss_streak: "Losing streak", kda: "KDA",
  deaths_avg: "Deaths per game", duration_min_avg: "Game length (minutes)",
  remake_share: "Share of remakes", surrendered_loss_share: "Share of surrendered losses",
  ranked_share: "Share of ranked games", aram_share: "Share of ARAM games",
  champion_diversity: "Champion variety", gap_hours_median: "Median hours between games",
  last_session_games: "Games in the last session", main_role_share: "Share in main role"
})
fmt = (v) => v === null ? "unknown" : Number.isInteger(v) ? v : +v.toFixed(2)
player === null ? html`<p class="small-note">No player matches these filters.</p>` : html`
<div class="stat-row">
  <div class="stat"><div class="value">${pct(player.churn)}</div>
    <div class="label">chance of stopping, LightGBM</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="value">${pct(player.recency)}</div>
    <div class="label">the recency rule alone</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="value"><span class="outcome ${player.churned ? "stopped" : "stayed"}">
    ${player.churned ? "Stopped playing" : "Kept playing"}</span></div>
    <div class="label">what actually happened</div></div>
  <div class="stat"><div class="value">${player.games_28d}</div>
    <div class="label">games in the 28 days before</div></div>
</div>`
```

### What moved the prediction

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
maxEffect = Math.max(...players.flatMap((p) => p.drivers.map((d) => Math.abs(d.effect))))
player === null ? html`` : html`<table class="drivers">
  ${player.drivers.map((d) => html`<tr>
    <td>${features[d.feature] ?? d.feature}</td>
    <td>${fmt(d.value)}</td>
    <td>${d.effect > 0 ? "raises" : "lowers"} the chance</td>
    <td style="width: 35%"><span class="bar" style="width: ${(100 * Math.abs(d.effect) / maxEffect).toFixed(0)}%;
      opacity: ${d.effect > 0 ? 1 : 0.45}"></span></td>
  </tr>`)}
</table>
<p class="small-note">SHAP values: how much each feature pushed this player's prediction up or
down from the average, in log-odds.</p>`
```

### Weekly games around the cutoff

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
weeks = player === null ? [] : player.weeks.map((games, i) => ({
  week: i - snapshot.meta.weeks.before, games,
  when: i < snapshot.meta.weeks.before ? "before the cutoff" : "after (the outcome)"
}))
Plot.plot({
  height: 240,
  marginLeft: 44,
  marginBottom: 44,
  x: {label: "Weeks from the cutoff", labelAnchor: "center", labelOffset: 38,
    domain: [-snapshot.meta.weeks.before, snapshot.meta.weeks.after], ticks: 12},
  y: {label: "Games", grid: true, nice: true},
  style: {background: "transparent", color: pal.ink2, fontSize: "13px"},
  marks: [
    Plot.rectY(weeks, {x1: "week", x2: (d) => d.week + 1, y: "games", insetLeft: 2, insetRight: 2,
      fill: (d) => d.week < 0 ? pal.blue : pal.blueLight, rx: 3}),
    Plot.ruleY([0], {stroke: pal.base}),
    Plot.ruleX([0], {stroke: pal.ink, strokeDasharray: "4,3"}),
    Plot.text([{x: 0}], {x: "x", frameAnchor: "top", dx: 6, text: () => "cutoff", textAnchor: "start", fill: pal.ink2}),
    Plot.tip(weeks, Plot.pointerX({x: (d) => d.week + 0.5, y: "games",
      title: (d) => `Week ${d.week >= 0 ? "+" : ""}${d.week} (${d.when}): ${d.games} games`}))
  ]
})
```

<p class="small-note">Bright bars are what the model saw; muted bars are the 4 weeks it was
predicting. A player "stopped" if all four muted bars are empty.</p>

### All matching players

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Inputs.table(searched, {
  columns: ["id", "region", "tier", "division", "churn", "churned", "games_28d"],
  header: {id: "Player", region: "Region", tier: "Tier", division: "Div.", churn: "Chance of stopping",
    churned: "Stopped?", games_28d: "Games, 28 days"},
  format: {churn: pct, churned: (c) => c ? "yes" : "no", tier: title},
  sort: "churn", reverse: true, rows: 12
})
```
